crossRefs.note: “Come, see a man who told me everything that I did. Can this be the Christ?”
He answered, “A man called Jesus made mud, anointed my eyes, and said to me, ‘Go to the pool of Siloam and wash.’ So I…
Then they asked him, “Where is he?” He said, “I don’t know.”
But he went out, and began to proclaim it much, and to spread about the matter, so that Jesus could no more openly…
Then they asked him, “Who is the man who said to you, ‘Take up your mat and walk’?”
Again therefore the Pharisees also asked him how he received his sight. He said to them, “He put mud on my eyes, I…
He therefore answered, “I don’t know if he is a sinner. One thing I do know: that though I was blind, now I see.”
The man answered them, “How amazing! You don’t know where he comes from, yet he opened my eyes.
They answered him, “You were altogether born in sins, and do you teach us?” Then they threw him out.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: The man went away, and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.
translations.bsb: And the man went away and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.
translations.kjv: The man departed, and told the Jews that it was Jesus, which had made him whole.
translations.asv: The man went away, and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him whole.
